species.name: Sunfolk
mechanics_first: **Versatile Traits - Skilled:** You gain **proficiency in one skill of your choice**.
**Versatile Traits - Bonus Language:** You gain **proficiency in one additional language of your choice**.
species.lore_and_flavor: Sunfolk are a Human-shaped offshoot, but this vault entry has a third Versatile Traits variant the importer has never seen before.
